blockers_must_fix_before_live.title: 444 Shadow Auth Violations Must Be Reduced Through Controlled Route Modernization Lanes
blockers_must_fix_before_live.description: 30+ API routes use legacy withAuth() pattern instead of modern ctx.verifiedSessionSnapshot. Modernization must proceed via controlled lanes (Phase R1, R2, etc.) with testing and validation per lane.
blockers_must_fix_before_live.lane_strategy: Convert 15 routes per week using close route pattern; test each lane independently

blockers_must_fix_before_live.title: DATABASE_URL Environment Configuration Required for Build
blockers_must_fix_before_live.description: Production build requires DATABASE_URL environment variable for Next.js static prerendering. Code compiles correctly; build is environment-gated, not code-gated.
blockers_must_fix_before_live.remediation: Configure DATABASE_URL in CI/deployment environment before npm run build

blockers_must_fix_before_live.title: Stripe Integration Route Uses Unmodernized Auth Pattern
blockers_must_fix_before_live.description: src/app/api/billing/upgrade/route.ts line 34 uses withAuth() instead of modern governance pattern.
blockers_must_fix_before_live.remediation: Apply close-route modernization pattern to /billing/upgrade route

blockers_must_fix_before_live.title: Rate Limiting Must Be Integrated Into Canonical Enforcement
blockers_must_fix_before_live.description: No request rate limits on endpoints. API vulnerable to abuse and resource exhaustion.
blockers_must_fix_before_live.remediation: Integrate rate-limit.ts middleware into canonical enforcement wrapper

blockers_must_fix_before_live.title: Production Deployment Documentation and Runbook Required
blockers_must_fix_before_live.description: No documented process for deploying OpsIQ to production. No Dockerfile, K8s manifests, or deployment runbooks.
blockers_must_fix_before_live.remediation: Create Dockerfile, K8s manifests, deployment runbook with rollback procedures

blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.title: Stripe Webhook Handler and Subscription Management
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.description: Stripe integration incomplete. No webhook handler for payment events. No subscription state management.
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.remediation: Implement webhook endpoint, subscription status tracking, event processing

blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.title: Subscription Tier Enforcement and Quota Checks
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.description: No quota enforcement or tier validation on POST endpoints. Cannot enforce Pro/Enterprise tiers.
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.remediation: Extend capability system with quota tracking; enforce tier limits at execution layer

blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.title: Audit Trail Export API Required for Enterprise Compliance
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.description: Audit events captured internally but no queryable/exportable API. Cannot satisfy SOC 2 or financial audit requirements.
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.remediation: Implement audit log queryable API with CSV/JSON export and filtering

blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.title: SSO Integration (Okta/Azure AD) Required for Enterprise Sales
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.description: Only basic email/password authentication. No support for Okta, Azure AD, or SAML2.0 SSO.
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.remediation: Extend NextAuth with OIDC provider support; implement Okta/Azure AD integration

blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.title: Data Encryption at Rest and Multi-Region Deployment
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.description: No encryption at rest for sensitive data. Single-region only. Cannot serve regulated industries (finance, healthcare, GDPR).
blockers_must_fix_before_paid_live.remediation: Implement Prisma field-level encryption; design multi-region replication strategy

blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.title: Advanced Runtime-Proof Tests (RP8/RP9)
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.description: Tests for failure injection and replay determinism are failing under extreme concurrency scenarios.
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.deferral_rationale: Phase R (runtime proof) can execute in parallel; not blockers for private beta

blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.title: Notification System (Email/SMS/Push)
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.description: No notifications for due actions, escalations, or critical events.
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.deferral_rationale: Nice-to-have for MVP; can add after private beta launch

blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.title: Logging Service Test Coverage
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.description: Logger service exists but has 0 tests.
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.deferral_rationale: Can defer if using third-party logging service

blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.title: Caching Service Test Coverage
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.description: Caching infrastructure exists but has 0 tests.
blockers_safe_to_defer_private_beta.deferral_rationale: Can defer caching layer if not used in MVP

critical_path.description: MUST_FIX blockers are sequential to live launch; MUST_FIX_BEFORE_PAID are sequential to revenue
private_beta_gates: BL-002: DATABASE_URL configured and build passes
paid_beta_gates: BL-004: Stripe webhooks and subscription management
BL-005: Tier enforcement and quota checks
